findings.evidence: Final object publication before metadata commit allowed concurrent GC to delete an about-to-be-referenced object.
findings.required_change: Unify object publication, pinning and GC/purge coordination.
findings.verification: Concurrent writer/commit/GC crash matrix never leaves a committed missing object.

findings.evidence: Call-span OS lock ownership, identity, ordering and exact lifecycle were underspecified.
findings.required_change: Freeze macOS/Linux lock primitive, process-local coordination, canonical multi-lock order and DB ordering.

findings.evidence: Connection-level PRAGMA, VFS, fork/thread and raw-file bypass rules were incomplete.
findings.required_change: Define one fail-closed connection factory and platform durability contract for every connection kind.
findings.verification: Bad PRAGMA/VFS/path/inherited connections fail before transactions.

findings.evidence: Database backup, object manifest and object copy could represent different logical snapshots.
findings.required_change: Bind export to one verified backup snapshot and durable retention hold before atomic bundle publication.
findings.verification: Concurrent writes/GC/crash cannot produce a successful mixed bundle.

findings.evidence: Upgrade lease, quiescence, atomic activation, rollback and fencing high-water protection were incomplete.
findings.required_change: Define import/migration activation state machine and prevent older state from unlocking unknown actions or reusing fences.
findings.verification: Crash at each activation step yields complete old/new state and stale bundle activation remains action-blocked.
